name: CAPA No-CNI (BYO-CNI) Cluster Provisioning - OpenShift 5.0 RC
description: Provision a ROSA HCP No-CNI cluster using CAPA with automated network and role configuration on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel. The ROSAControlPlane network block sets networkType: Other, disabling the default OVNKubernetes CNI so the user brings and installs their own CNI plugin (ACM-21174-NoCNI).

playbooks.name: Create CAPA No-CNI Cluster
playbooks.description: Provisions a ROSA HCP No-CNI (BYO-CNI) cluster (network.networkType: Other) using CAPA with ROSANetwork and ROSARoleConfig automation on OpenShift 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel

documentation.overview: This test suite provisions a ROSA HCP No-CNI (BYO-CNI) cluster on the OpenShift 5.0 release candidate (5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel) against the MCE 5.0 RC hub. It uses the 5.0 feature template rosa-no-cni-cluster, which derives from the 4.20 combined-automation template (full ROSANetwork + ROSARoleConfig automation, no hard-coded ARNs) and sets network.networkType: Other on the ROSAControlPlane.
prerequisites: MCE 5.0 RC hub cluster with CAPI/CAPA configured

quick_start.description: Using name_prefix automatically sets cluster_name and domain_prefix consistently

customization.openshift_version: OpenShift version to deploy (default: 5.0.0-ec.6, candidate channel)
customization.channel_group: Update channel: stable, fast, or candidate (this suite uses candidate for the 5.0 RC)
customization.network_type: ROSAControlPlane network.networkType enum (OVNKubernetes|Other); this suite uses Other for BYO-CNI

expected_results: ROSANetwork resource created with CloudFormation stack
ROSARoleConfig resource created with IAM roles and OIDC
Cluster provisioned without the default OVNKubernetes CNI
User can install and manage their own CNI plugin on the cluster
